zh-CN.headlineFull: 规则、AI与韧性继续变化；经营边界同步重写
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟小包关税、AI透明度义务、单人创业、航天、气候与健康共同提示：增长必须匹配治理和系统韧性。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 机会仍在扩张，真正稀缺的是把规则、技术与风险一起管好的能力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 今天不是一盏警报灯，而是一整排仪表盘同时亮起。

en-US.headlineFact: Rules, AI and resilience keep shifting
en-US.headlineFull: Rules, AI and resilience keep shifting; business boundaries are being rewritten
en-US.intro: EU parcel duties, AI transparency rules, solo entrepreneurship, spaceflight, climate and health all show that growth must match governance and resilience.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Opportunity is expanding; the scarce capability is managing rules, technology and risk together.
en-US.doudouQuote: Today is not one warning light; it is a whole dashboard lighting up.

Preliminary Report
sources.publisher: United Nations Independent International Scientific Panel on AI

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟低值包裹每件€3关税进入磨合期
zh-CN.headlineView: 卖家运营必须重算落地成本
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟低值包裹每件€3关税进入磨合期；卖家运营必须重算落地成本
zh-CN.intro: €150以下免税门槛已取消；IOSS、HS归类、申报担保、商品识别与结账总价透明度成为日常运营核心。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境转化率越来越取决于顾客下单前能否看见真实总价。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 便宜包裹不再等于简单包裹。

en-US.headlineFact: EU €3 low-value duty enters operational phase
en-US.headlineFull: EU €3 low-value duty enters operational phase; sellers must recalculate landed cost
en-US.intro: The exemption under €150 has ended; IOSS, HS classification, declaration guarantees, product identification and checkout transparency are now core operations.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border conversion increasingly depends on showing the true total before checkout.
en-US.doudouQuote: A cheap parcel is no longer a simple parcel.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟AI内容标识义务来到关键日期
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟AI内容标识义务来到关键日期；透明应进入输出链路
zh-CN.intro: 面向公众的AI生成或操纵内容需要更清晰披露；产品团队应把可识别标记、来源记录与发布流程前置。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 透明不是发布后的补丁，而应成为模型输出链路的一部分。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先让内容会说明自己从哪里来。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: EU AI content marking reaches a key date
en-US.headlineView: transparency belongs in the output chain
en-US.headlineFull: EU AI content marking reaches a key date; transparency belongs in the output chain
en-US.intro: Public-facing AI-generated or manipulated content needs clearer disclosure, making marking, provenance records and publishing controls product requirements.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Transparency is not a post-release patch; it belongs in the model output chain.
en-US.doudouQuote: First teach content to explain where it came from.

sources.title: Preliminary Report
sources.publisher: United Nations Independent International Scientific Panel on AI

zh-CN.headlineFact: 16万款产品研究显示AI扩大单人创业入口
zh-CN.headlineView: 头部成果仍更偏向团队
zh-CN.headlineFull: 16万款产品研究显示AI扩大单人创业入口；头部成果仍更偏向团队
zh-CN.intro: Product Hunt大样本研究显示生成式AI提高了单人创作者进入市场的比例，但高排名成果仍更多由团队获得。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI降低了做出来的门槛，却没有消除协作、判断、分销与信任的复利。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一个人更容易开场，但冲进决赛圈仍要借力。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: Study of 160,000 products finds more solo entry with AI
en-US.headlineFull: Study of 160,000 products finds more solo entry with AI; top outcomes still favor teams
en-US.intro: A large Product Hunt study finds generative AI increased solo creator entry, while team projects remained more common among the highest-ranked outcomes.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI lowers the barrier to building, but not the compounding value of collaboration, judgment, distribution and trust.
en-US.doudouQuote: One person can start more easily, but reaching the final still takes leverage.

sources.title: Generative AI and the Rise of Solo Entrepreneurship

zh-CN.headlineFact: NASA宇航员结束241天任务安全返航
zh-CN.headlineView: 长期任务数据回到地面
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA宇航员结束241天任务安全返航；长期任务数据回到地面
zh-CN.intro: Chris Williams与两名俄罗斯宇航员乘联盟飞船着陆，长期任务数据将继续支持人类深空飞行研究。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 每次平安返航，都是把太空经验带回下一次更远航程。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 在轨241天，最后一段路仍要靠降落伞稳稳收尾。

en-US.headlineFact: NASA astronaut returns safely after 241 days
en-US.headlineFull: NASA astronaut returns safely after 241 days; long-duration data comes home
en-US.intro: Chris Williams and two Roscosmos cosmonauts landed in a Soyuz spacecraft, bringing long-duration mission experience back for future exploration research.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Every safe return brings spaceflight experience home for the next, farther journey.
en-US.doudouQuote: After 241 days in orbit, the last mile still depends on a parachute.

sources.title: NASA-ISRO NISAR Satellite Opens Data Vault, Shows Antarctic Hummingbird

zh-CN.headlineFact: NASA公布月球航天器技术演示任务
zh-CN.headlineView: 实验室能力走向真实飞行
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA公布月球航天器技术演示任务；实验室能力走向真实飞行
zh-CN.intro: 新任务将验证面向月球轨道与深空探索的关键航天器能力，把实验室技术推向真实飞行环境。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 航天创新的分水岭，是从可行原理跨到可重复飞行。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 技术走出实验室，才知道能不能在月球边上干活。

en-US.headlineFact: NASA announces a Moon spacecraft demo mission
en-US.headlineFull: NASA announces a Moon spacecraft demo mission; lab capability moves into flight
en-US.intro: The mission will demonstrate spacecraft technologies for lunar and deep-space exploration in a real flight environment.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The dividing line in space innovation is moving from a feasible principle to repeatable flight.
en-US.doudouQuote: A technology must leave the lab to prove it can work near the Moon.

sources.title: NASA-ISRO NISAR Satellite Opens Data Vault, Shows Antarctic Hummingbird

zh-CN.headlineFact: 雷暴引发俄勒冈多处山火
zh-CN.headlineFull: 雷暴引发俄勒冈多处山火；烟雾与空气风险叠加
zh-CN.intro: 中央与东部俄勒冈数十起火点再次提醒：极端天气、干燥燃料与空气质量风险会快速叠加。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 韧性不是灾后恢复，而是灾前主动减少系统脆弱点。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 闪电点火很快，预警和燃料管理要更早。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与森林。

en-US.headlineFull: Lightning ignites multiple Oregon wildfires; smoke and air risks compound
en-US.intro: Dozens of fires in central and eastern Oregon show how extreme weather, dry fuels and air-quality risks can compound quickly.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Resilience is not only recovery; it is reducing weak points before disaster.
en-US.doudouQuote: Lightning starts fires quickly, so warnings and fuel management must start earlier.

sources.title: Previous prescribed burns saved thousands of ancient sequoias during historically unprecedented wildfires

zh-CN.headlineFact: 最多45%失智风险可预防或延缓
zh-CN.headlineFull: 最多45%失智风险可预防或延缓；干预必须更早发生
zh-CN.intro: WHO指南把运动、教育、心血管健康与社会连接等可干预因素纳入更早、更持续的公共健康行动。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 公共健康最有价值的投资，往往发生在疾病确诊之前。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 大脑也需要长期保养，不是坏了才修。

en-US.headlineFact: Up to 45% of dementia risk is preventable
en-US.headlineFull: Up to 45% of dementia risk is preventable; intervention must start earlier
en-US.intro: WHO guidance brings modifiable factors such as exercise, education, cardiovascular health and social connection into earlier, sustained action.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The most valuable public-health investment often happens before diagnosis.
en-US.doudouQuote: The brain needs maintenance too, not repairs only after failure.

sources.title: New WHO guidelines: up to 45% of dementia risk could be prevented or delayed

zh-CN.headlineFull: 全球电力覆盖率升至92%；互联网接入接近74%
zh-CN.intro: 联合国2026可持续发展报告显示长期投入带来进展，但债务、冲突、气候与援助收缩仍在拖慢脆弱国家。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的进步要同时看平均线向上，以及谁仍被留在系统之外。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 世界连上电和网了，下一步是别让最后一公里掉线。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：可持续发展。

en-US.headlineFull: Global electricity access reaches 92%; internet access approaches 74%
en-US.intro: The UN 2026 SDG report shows long-term gains, while debt, conflict, climate stress and aid cuts still slow vulnerable countries.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Real progress means tracking both the rising average and who remains outside the system.
en-US.doudouQuote: The world is connecting to power and the internet; now keep the last mile online.

sources.title: WTO issues new edition of World Tariff Profiles
